name: quioteframework/filesystem
description: Quiote's filesystem subsystem: FilesystemAdapterInterface/ListableFilesystemInterface, FilesystemManager, FilesystemDriverRegistry, LocalFilesystemAdapter, the object-store-backed adapter base classes cloud filesystem drivers extend, and ObjectStoreSessionPersistence, the equivalent base for cloud session drivers. Opt-in via the plugin system (`plugins: [Quiote\Filesystem\FilesystemPlugin]`), split out of the framework core so it releases independently.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/filesystem/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
